g.text: After a no-copy one-Rail baseline, two Rails no longer win consistently
Same optimized client in both arms; ten AB/BA process blocks per cell. Each dot is one paired block.
Intervals resample ten paired blocks (20,000 seeded draws); VM/RXE software results, not physical HCA aggregation.
